title: Embrocate
summary: EM'BROCATE, verb transitive [Gr. to moisten, to rain.] In surgery and medicine, to moisten and rub a diseased part of the body, with a liquid substance, as with spirit, oil, etc., by means of a cloth

inlines.v: EM'BROCATE, verb transitive [Gr. to moisten, to rain.] In surgery and medicine, to moisten and rub a diseased part of the body, with a liquid substance, as with spirit, oil, etc., by means of a cloth or spunge.
